training_text: Learn the jet on the ground at your base: start the engine, then taxi and take off.
desc_startup: Start the engine and bring the avionics up.
brief_startup: The jet stands cold on its parking spot. Start the engine (Ctrl+E) and bring the avionics up.
brief_takeoff: Ask the tower for start-up, taxi and take-off (Ctrl+T), taxi to runway %s and take off on its heading.
pass_startup: The engine at idle with the avionics up, within %s.
pass_takeoff: Airborne with the gear up, on the runway heading (±%d°), within %s.
remark_above: Lift-off %s above the reference speed for %s.
remark_below: Lift-off %s below the reference speed for %s.
remark_centreline: The roll held the centreline within %s.
antialiasing_note: Smooths the edges of the jets and the ground.
upscaling_note: Renders the 3D view smaller and scales it up, for a higher frame rate.
terrain_detail_note: Lower it if the frame rate drops.
clouds_note: Volumetric clouds need a strong graphics card.
rain_note: Falling rain, drops on the canopy and wet ground, where a mission has no weather of its own.
night_lights_note: Glowing lights at night: the bases, the jets' navigation lights, stars and the moon.
water_note: Waves and reflections on the sea.
vsync_note: Frames in step with the display: no tearing.
language_note: Menus, briefings and debriefs. Radio voices stay in English.
flight_controls_note: Fly by joystick or by the keyboard.
rudder_note: Pedals or the keyboard's rudder keys.
throttle_note: A throttle lever or the keyboard.
stick_response_note: Soft centre adds a small dead zone and a gentle curve.
invulnerable_note: Hits and collisions leave the jet whole.
no_crashes_note: Hitting the ground does not end the flight.
no_blackouts_note: No grey-out or black-out under high G.
